required_gate: Root grants an exclusive serial slot only after all other builds, GUI, resource observations and heavy hashing stop. No invocation is made by preparation.

production_binding.excluded: The unique main.o; renderer target32objects not linked. Existing main production moc/uic/qrc are reused; only this private body's moc/object and executable are freshly generated.
production_binding.old_evidence_limit: The old95-input independent GUI result supplies fixture/behavior evidence only. It is not used as current447 source/object or measurement proof.
production_binding.future_checks: Compare full formal snapshot set+SHA, completed native receipts/main/helper SHA, all210 original fresh objects, exact177 Makefile object->source mappings, generated UI/moc/qrc/predefs before/after. Freeze private body/fixture/controller/observer/process helper/inventory helper independently. All heavy hashes occur outside measured phases.

dataset.schema_owners: Current real ProjectsStore and QcStore via authoritative qc_history_gui_fixture.h, no manual schema replacement
dataset.stores: Two SQL owners, one fixture worker thread; not the unified shell's full worker/process set
dataset.result_type: Calibration2 only, not Time -> Original guessing
dataset.order_contract: Original previous-then-current, date/time/id DESC within batch, original reverse trace start retained
dataset.units: Real legacy rows are UnknownLegacy. Whole card stays raw, Count3, Mean/SD/CV/state em dash, no target/bound lines.
dataset.write_scope: Only new marked anonymous runtime, seeded before timing by test fixture. No reference/production DB or INI or authentication values read. Complete QC and catalog SQL table/value/type row images are compared in memory before/after each scenario, outside response heartbeat/resource window, alongside the six history rows. Raw images/runtime DBs are not hashed/copied/printed/archived.
dataset.load_shape_limit: Six rows and one3-point card is a small fixed-load baseline, not a10000-row capacity/clinical/data-rate specification.

response.process: One fresh private QtTest process; original QualityControlPage inside1600x900 scroll host; xcb/Fusion/Noto Sans CJK SC11, scale1
response.sequence: B,B,A,A repeated10:20 project switches and20 same-project refreshes by queued actual QTest mouse events on original buttons selected by stable qcAssociationId
response.startup_queries: One real automatic history query is setup and is counted separately, not a latency sample. Total history queries in response process must be41; measured operations never exceed40. Resource process separately performs one setup query only.
response.preconditions: Before each action, host active/exposed1600x900, original target center visible/enabled, page not busy. Preparation is outside measured queued-action interval; no blind sleeps, retry loop or injected worker delay.
response.clock: POSIX CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds; absolute ns are decimal JSON strings to avoid binary64 integer loss; derived milliseconds are double
endpoints: queued_mouse_action_ns: private queued input action posted
mouse_dispatch_ns/mouse_press_ns/mouse_release_ns: QtTest dispatch and event-filter observations, not a physical device click
first_busy_ns: GUI observes original page busy
request_signal_observed_gui_ns: observer after production requestHistory queued-send slot; this observer can occur before or after worker emission if GUI is preempted

worker_reply_emitted_ns: private QObject relay in the original worker timestamps inside historyReady emission, before production page accept connection is queued; relay only emits scalar values back via QueuedConnection
worker_reply_received_gui_ns: GUI receives relay value snapshot; no worker writes GUI vectors/JSON/QSignalSpy
page_accepted_ns: original operationFinished(loadHistory) observed after presenter accepts/render data
card_data_ready_ns: actual card identity/3point values/unit/count/date labels validated in GUI
plot_paint_event_delivered_ns: first actual Paint event on that new QualityChart, before paintEvent
plot_paint_dispatch_return_observed_ns: a zero-queued callback after that Paint event dispatch returns; CPU processing return observation only
response.paint_limit: No production source hooks, synthetic successful reply, forced render/grab in timing, compositor/present hook or physical display measurement. Plot CPU paint dispatch return is not screen compositing, pixels visible to a user, total card-label paint completion or physical input latency.
response.heartbeat: 5ms precise GUI timer during response scenario; raw planned/observed/interval/delay records retained. Prior observed dispatch is next baseline, not catch-up bursts. No per-sample JSON/filesystem write in this window; flush after heartbeat stops, including destructor failure partials. Input readiness/QtTest dispatch/value checking/timestamp relay still add observation overhead; this is a GUI-loop proxy under that declared harness, not pure production event-loop or physical-input latency. Timer stopped before any resource phase.
response.per_sample_checks: New unique request and expected control/association; actual worker reply; raw10/100 previous first value,3valid points/unknown units/no clinical state, page idle. No weakened original functional assertion.
response.statistics: Retain every raw ns/ms and independently recompute nearest-rank p95/p99/max from40 samples plus heartbeat. With40 samples p99 equals max; no approved response threshold or budget is invented.

resource.process: Separate fresh private QtTest process using same binary/native binding; setup creates real6rows, shows valid original history card and observes its Paint dispatch return
resource.scenario: Already loaded one3-point original card idle for30seconds. No periodic SQL, trace loop,5ms response heartbeat or image export during window. This measures retained page resource baseline, not active maximum-rate query/render load.
resource.timer: Private precise timer retains normal event loop and re-arms if it fires before absolute deadline; normal page requestLeave/store close/thread join occurs after deadline, without ordinary SIGTERM
resource.observer: Private observer reuses formal observe_linux_process.sample_process read-only /proc fields, sampling approximately100ms; raw startup/loaded/close samples retained and only ready-window samples summarized
resource.fields: CPU ticks and one-logical-core percent over actual first-to-last sampled span, VmRSS/VmHWM/Pss in KiB, Threads, fd_count; unavailable PSS stays null; first/last sample gaps and coverage explicitly retained
resource.sampling_completeness: For declared100ms observation, require >=250 actual window samples, first/last gaps<=250ms and maximum internal gap<=500ms. These are measurement-data coverage criteria, not CPU/RSS/response/clinical budget thresholds; incomplete observation keeps raw data and cannot pass.
resource.exit: Real child/outer observer exits, logs/XML and owned session stop recorded before assertions. Timeout/failure retained; outer bounded helper cleans residual descendants, never infers child exit0 from group cleanup.
resource.storage: After process normal exit only: counts of all tables in the newly generated anonymous DBs plus file/log bytes. No runtime DB contents hashed, copied or archived; no authentication values.
resource.comparison_limit: Private QtTest page/twoowners/oneworker cannot be called whole-program RSS/CPU or compared as a delta against the separate nine-SQL+two-INI+loopback whole-program baseline. No RK, same-board realtime, approved budget or long stability claim.

failure_policy: Fresh attempt only, serial compiler job1, no old test binary/no hidden retry. Actual command exit/raw logs saved first; failures keep partial metrics and prevent subsequent phase. Source/input drift or unconfirmed process group blocks pass.
pending: actual current447 object/source recheck at granted slot
